message: Bring in bug and security fixes from upstream Baserow up to 2.4.0.
bullet_points: Data syncs from user-provided URLs can be blocked from reaching private addresses (BASEROW_DATA_SYNC_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ADDRESS), changing a data sync or SMTP/Slack connection target requires re-entering its credential, those credentials are write-only and left out of workspace exports, and the data sync properties endpoint checks workspace permissions.
Importing with upsert checks the row update permission before the import starts.
WebSocket connections no longer stall under load, and realtime replay uses less storage by compacting expired events.

Grid view: no race between search, filter and sort refreshes, edited values show immediately while saves are queued, set-based ordering for multiple select and collaborator group-bys, and NaN/infinite aggregations no longer break the response.
CSV values with unquoted newlines return a validation error instead of a server error, and many-to-many value order is kept when updating a row.

Application Builder: localized number inputs validate correctly, zero shows in numeric inputs, workflow actions only accept events their element can fire, page roles survive publishing, update row actions require a row ID, and the editor waits for data sources before rendering elements.
Backend memory is released after each API response, and periodic field updates stop at a deadline instead of being killed.
